integrity: Two-term asymptotic derived with explicit finite-domain computations; no independent validation or mathematical audit is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The proof uses the published 2026 pointwise residue characterization as a premise. It applies to positive odd indices only. Historical-priority review of later sections of the 2026 source was incomplete; an equivalent earlier prime-square asymptotic may exist.
title: Two-term rare-residue asymptotics for odd strongly unimodal sequences
